bull_bear.body:
- "Shareholder Commitment: Dividends paid in 10 out of 12 FY since FY15"; average payout on face value of 9.33% since FY15, or 11.2% "Excl. FY2020 (COVID-19) & FY2025" ("No dividend declared during the pandemic").
- FY2026 dividend is the "Highest-ever payout [Interim + Final(Proposed)]" at 20% (on face value).
- "2024: Raised ₹155 Crores capital" per the operational timeline; networth ₹286.79 Cr in FY26 versus ₹180.99 Cr in FY25.
- Operating profits are "systematically reinvested into internal treasury book compounding since 1995", with the balance sheet framed as the enabler for larger client assets under custody and "massive margin funding balances".
- "Fiscal Discipline - Advance tax paid — (All working days of FY 25-26)" and "Governance - Standards exceed regulatory floor" are listed among the corporate values.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Indo Thai Securities Limited is a full-stack financial services company with 31 years of uninterrupted operations, headquartered in Indore and listed on both NSE and BSE", serving "HNI, UHNI and corporate clients across equity broking, F&O, commodities, currency derivatives, depository services, wealth management, and algorithmic trading."
- Five exchange memberships (NSE, BSE, MCX, MSEI, NCDEX) plus DP of CDSL: "Full-stack exchange presence across NSE, BSE, MCX, NCDEX, MSEI & DP of CDSL", and SEBI-registered Research Analyst and AMFI mutual fund distributor.
- Client model is "Relationship-first, not transaction-first" with "Depth of relationships over scale-driven acquisition" - "Advisory-backed wealth creation model", "Diversified ecosystem, single platform", "Quality acquisition, long-term retention".
- "The Compounding Flywheel Model": client franchise generates recurring fee and interest income, operating profits are "systematically reinvested into internal treasury book compounding since 1995", and "A larger, highly capitalized ... balance sheet dramatically deepens Indo Thai's institutional credibility" to win larger client assets.
- Intellectual-capital claims: "Deep intellectual capital in core operations", "Strong women representation across our team", "30% of seniors have tenures between 20 to 25 years".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Demerger] Proposed 1:1 strategic demerger separating Indo Thai Financial Services (broking, distribution, treasury desk, IB & research - 99.6% of revenue) from Femto Green Hydrogen, Indo Thai Realties, the planned Category II AIF and Indo Thai Globe Fin (IFSC); status: "BSE / NSE — No adverse observations · March 18, 2026 · Ratio 1:1 · NCLT filing in progress", after which "every shareholder holds two separately valued companies."
- [Demerger rationale] Stated unlock: "Broking + IB as a pure-play financial services listing · Peer comparisons become direct and clean", and "Cleantech investors who avoid broking stocks can now enter · Femto raises capital at tech valuations, not financial services multiples".
- [Femto IP] "PCT Patent Filed — Jan 2026 (Patented on the name of Mr. Nandan Kundetkar)", application PCT/IN2026/050049 "Method for Treating Fuel with Electromagnetic Waves"; a concurrent US utility patent is active with Mr. Kundetkar as first inventor; FGHL holds exclusive commercialization rights for surface transportation across India & Asia; Indo Thai Securities owns 56.85% of Femto.
- [Revenue concentration] Treasury / fair-value gains contributed ₹79.05 Cr of FY26 revenue versus ₹8.34 Cr in FY25, described as "the systematic compounding of a treasury book built over three decades, not a one-time trading windfall"; fee & commission income grew only +5.7% (₹10.70 Cr vs ₹10.12 Cr).
- [Third-party market data] Market-context figures are attributed to external houses, not the company: India HNWI wealth $2.3 Trillion by FY2029 (Deloitte India, Jan 2025), UHNWI growth +50% by 2028 (Knight Frank), PMS + AIF AUM ₹100L Cr+ by 2030 (EY-Julius Bear India), AIF industry AUM ₹53-56L Cr by 2030 (CRISIL Research), PMS industry AUM ₹80L Cr+ by 2030 (Bloomberg / PMS Bazaar), India alternative AUM $247 Billion by 2029 (CareEdge Research).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Indo Thai Securities as a 31-year-old, Indore-headquartered "full-stack financial services company" whose HNI/UHNI broking-and-depository franchise funds a compounding in-house treasury book (76% of FY26 revenue), with a proposed 1:1 demerger that would separate the regulated broking platform from its clean-tech (Femto Green Hydrogen) and real estate subsidiaries.
